verses.geez: በነገር፡ ዘይትጋነይ፡ ይመይጥ፡ መዓተ፡ ባሕቱ፡ ቃል፡ ማኅዘኒ፡ ያነሥዕ፡ ጋእዘ።
verses.translation: Anger slays even wise men; yet a submissive answer turns away wrath: but a grievous word stirs up anger.

translations.lxx: Anger slays even wise men; yet a submissive answer turns away wrath: but a grievous word stirs up anger.
translations.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
translations.ron: Un răspuns blând domoleşte mânia, iar un cuvânt aspru aţâţă mânia.
translations.grk: Ὀργὴ ἀπόλλυσι καὶ φρονίμους, ἀπόκρισις δὲ ὑποπίπτουσα ἀποστρέφει θυμὸν, λόγος δὲ λυπηρὸς ἐγείρει ὀργάς.

verses.geez: ልበ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ሠናየ፡ ተአምር፡ ወአፈ፡ ዐብዳንሰ፡ ይዜኑ፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: The tongue of the wise knows what is good: but the mouth of the foolish tells out evil things.

translations.lxx: The tongue of the wise knows what is good: but the mouth of the foolish tells out evil things.
translations.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
translations.ron: Limba celor înţelepţi picură ştiinţă, iar gura celor nebuni revarsă prostie.
translations.grk: Γλῶσσα σοφῶν καλὰ ἐπίσταται, στόμα δὲ ἀφρόνων ἀναγγέλλει κακά.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካን፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወያስተሐይፅ፡ እኩያነ፡ ወኄራነ።
verses.translation: The eyes of the Lord behold both the evil and the good in every place.

translations.lxx: The eyes of the Lord behold both the evil and the good in every place.
translations.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
translations.ron: Ochii Domnului sunt pretutindeni, veghind asupra celor buni şi asupra celor răi.
translations.grk: Ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου σκοπεύουσι κακούς τε καὶ ἀγαθούς.

verses.geez: መፈውሰ፡ ልሳን፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዘሰ፡ የዓቅብ፡ ይመልእ፡ መንፈሰ።
verses.translation: The wholesome tongue is a tree of life, and he that keeps it shall be filled with understanding.

translations.lxx: The wholesome tongue is a tree of life, and he that keeps it shall be filled with understanding.
translations.kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
translations.ron: Limba dulce este pom al vieţii, iar limba vicleană zdrobeşte inima.
translations.grk: Ἴασις γλώσσης δένδρον ζωῆς, ὁ δὲ συντηρῶν αὐτὴν πλησθήσεται πνεύματος.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ዓብድ፡ ያስተአኪ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ አብ፡ ወዘሰ፡ የዓቅብ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: A fool scorns his father's instruction: but he that keeps his commandments is more prudent. In abounding righteousness is great strength: but the ungodly shall utterly perish from the earth.

translations.lxx: A fool scorns his father's instruction: but he that keeps his commandments is more prudent. In abounding righteousness is great strength: but the ungodly shall utterly perish from the earth.
translations.kjv: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
translations.ron: Nebunul nu ia în seamă învăţătura tatălui său, iar cine trage folos din certare se face mai înţelept.
translations.grk: Ἄφρων μυκτηρίζει παιδείαν πατρὸς, ὁ δὲ φυλάσσων ἐντολὰς, πανουργότερος· ἐν πλεοναζούσῃ δικαιοσύνῃ ἰσχὺς πολλὴ, οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς ὁλόῤῥιζοι ἐκ γῆς ἀπολοῦνται.

verses.geez: ወእደ፡ ትበዝኅ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ኃይል፡ ብዙኅ፡ ወረሲዓንሰ፡ እምሥርዎሙ፡ እምድር፡ ይሤረዉ።
verses.translation: In the houses of the righteous is much strength: but the fruits of the ungodly shall perish.

translations.lxx: In the houses of the righteous is much strength: but the fruits of the ungodly shall perish.
translations.kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
translations.ron: În casa celui drept sunt comori fără de număr; în câştigul celui fără de lege este tulburare.
translations.grk: Οἴκοις δικαίων ἰσχὺς πολλή, καρποὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολοῦνται.

verses.geez: ከናፍረ፡ ጠበብት፡ እሡር፡ በአእምሮ፡ ወልበ፡ ዐብዳንሰ፡ አኮ፡ ጽኑዕ።
verses.translation: The lips of the wise are bound by discretion: but the hearts of the foolish are not safe.

translations.lxx: The lips of the wise are bound by discretion: but the hearts of the foolish are not safe.
translations.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
translations.ron: Buzele celor înţelepţi răspândesc ştiinţa, dar inima celor nebuni nu.
translations.grk: Χείλη σοφῶν δέδεται αἰσθήσει, καρδίαι δὲ ἀφρόνων οὐκ ἀσφαλεῖς.

verses.geez: መሥዋዕተ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ርኩስ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወጸሎተ፡ ኄራንሰ፡ ሥሙር፡ በኀቤሁ።
verses.translation: The sacrifices of the ungodly are an abomination to the Lord; but the prayers of them that walk honestly are acceptable with him.

translations.lxx: The sacrifices of the ungodly are an abomination to the Lord; but the prayers of them that walk honestly are acceptable with him.
translations.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
translations.ron: Jertfa celor fără de lege este urâciune înaintea Domnului, iar rugăciunea celor drepţi este plăcerea Lui.
translations.grk: Θυσίαι ἀσεβῶν βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ, εὐχαὶ δὲ κατευθυνόντων δεκταὶ παρʼ αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ርኩስ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍኖተ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ወለእለሰ፡ ይዴግንዋ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ያፈቅሮሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: The ways of an ungodly man are an abomination to the Lord; but he loves those that follow after righteousness.

translations.lxx: The ways of an ungodly man are an abomination to the Lord; but he loves those that follow after righteousness.
translations.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
translations.ron: Calea celui nelegiuit este urâciune înaintea Domnului, dar El iubeşte pe cel ce umblă după dreptate.
translations.grk: Βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ ὁδοὶ ἀσεβοῦς, διώκοντας δὲ δικαιοσύνην ἀγαπᾷ.

verses.geez: ትእምርተ፡ የዋሃን፡ ትትዓወቅ፡ በኀበ፡ እለ፡ የኀልፉ፡ ወእለሰ፡ ይጸልኡ፡ ዝልፈተ፡ ይመውቱ፡ በእኩይ።
verses.translation: The instruction of the simple is known by them that pass by; but they that hate reproofs die disgracefully.

translations.lxx: The instruction of the simple is known by them that pass by; but they that hate reproofs die disgracefully.
translations.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
translations.ron: O certare aspră capătă ,el ce părăseşte cărarea; cel ce urgiseşte mustrarea va muri.
translations.grk: Παιδεία ἀκάκου γνωρίζεται ὑπὸ τῶν παριόντων, οἱ δὲ μισοῦντες ἐλέγχους τελευτῶσιν αἰσχρῶς.

verses.geez: ገሃነም፡ ወሞት፡ ክሡታን፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እፎ፡ እንከ፡ ልበ፡ ሰብእኒ።
verses.translation: Hell and destruction are manifest to the Lord; how shall not also be the hearts of men?

translations.lxx: Hell and destruction are manifest to the Lord; how shall not also be the hearts of men?
translations.kjv: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
translations.ron: Iadul şi adâncul sunt cunoscute Domnului, cu atât mai vârtos inimile fiilor oamenilor.
translations.grk: Ἅδης καὶ ἀπώλεια φανερὰ παρὰ τῷ Κυρίῳ· πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ αἱ καρδίαι τῶν ἀνθρώπων;

verses.geez: ኢያፈቅር፡ ዓብድ፡ እለ፡ ይጌሥፅዎ፡ ወምስለ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ኢይትናገር።
verses.translation: An uninstructed person will not love those that reprove him; neither will he associate with the wise.

translations.lxx: An uninstructed person will not love those that reprove him; neither will he associate with the wise.
translations.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
translations.ron: Celui batjocoritor nu-i place dojana; de aceea el nu se îndreaptă spre cei înţelepţi.
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἀγαπήσει ἀπαίδευτος τοὺς ἐλέγχοντας αὐτόν, μετὰ δὲ σοφῶν οὐχ ὁμιλήσει.

verses.geez: ልብ፡ እምከመ፡ ትትፌሣሕ፡ ትበርህ፡ ገጽ፡ ወእመሰ፡ ተኀዝን፡ ትዴምን።
verses.translation: When the heart rejoices the countenance is cheerful; but when it is in sorrow, the countenance is sad.

translations.lxx: When the heart rejoices the countenance is cheerful; but when it is in sorrow, the countenance is sad.
translations.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
translations.ron: O inimă veselă înseninează faţa, iar când inima e tristă şi duhul e fără de curaj.
translations.grk: Καρδίας εὐφραινομένης πρόσωπον θάλλει, ἐν δὲ λύπαις οὔσης σκυθρωπάζει.

verses.geez: ልብ፡ ርትዕት፡ ተኃሥሥ፡ አእምሮ፡ አፈ፡ ዓብዳንሰ፡ የኃሥሥ፡ እከየ፡ ኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ።
verses.translation: An upright heart seeks discretion; but the mouth of the uninstructed will experience evils.

translations.lxx: An upright heart seeks discretion; but the mouth of the uninstructed will experience evils.
translations.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
translations.ron: Inima înţeleaptă caută ştiinţa, iar gura celor nebuni se simte mulţumită cu nebunia.
translations.grk: Καρδία ὀρθὴ ζητεῖ αἴσθησιν, στόμα δὲ ἀπαιδεύτων γνώσεται κακά.

verses.geez: አዕንተ፡ እኩያን፡ ይሴፈዋ፡ እኩየ፡ ወኄራንሰ፡ ያረምሙ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ።
verses.translation: The eyes of the wicked are always looking for evil things; but the good are always quiet.

translations.lxx: The eyes of the wicked are always looking for evil things; but the good are always quiet.
translations.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
translations.ron: Toate zilele celui sărac sunt rele, dar inima mulţumită este un ospăţ necurmat.
translations.grk: Πάντα τὸν χρόνον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τῶν κακῶν προσδέχονται κακὰ, οἱ δὲ ἀγαθοὶ ἡσυχάζουσι διαπαντός.

verses.geez: ትኄይስ፡ ንስቲት፡ መክፈልት፡ ዘበፍርሃተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እመዛግብት፡ ዓበይት፡ ዘበኢፈሪህ።
verses.translation: Better is a small portion with the fear of the Lord, than great treasures without the fear of the Lord.

translations.lxx: Better is a small portion with the fear of the Lord, than great treasures without the fear of the Lord.
translations.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
translations.ron: Mai bine puţin intru frica lui Dumnezeu, decât vistierie mare şi tulburare (multă).
translations.grk: Κρεῖσσον μικρὰ μερὶς μετὰ φόβου Κυρίου, ἢ θησαυροὶ μεγάλοι μετὰ ἀφοβίας.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ፍተ፡ ሐምል፡ ፍቅር፡ ዘቦቱ፡ እምላሕም፡ መግዝዕ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ጽልእ።
verses.translation: Better is an entertainment of herbs with friendliness and kindness, than a feast of calves, with enmity.

translations.lxx: Better is an entertainment of herbs with friendliness and kindness, than a feast of calves, with enmity.
translations.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
translations.ron: Mai mult face o mâncare de verdeţuri şi cu dragoste, decât un bou îngrăşat şi cu ură.
translations.grk: Κρείσσων ξενισμὸς μετὰ λαχάνων πρὸς φιλίαν καὶ χάριν, ἢ παράθεσις μόσχων μετὰ ἔχθρας.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ መዓትም፡ ያስተዴሉ፡ ጋእዘ፡ ወመስተዓግሥሂ፡ ብእሲ፡ እንተ፡ ኮነትኒ፡ ያጠፍእ፡ ወረሲዕሰ፡ ያነሥእ፡ ጥቀ፡ ጽልእ።
verses.translation: A passionate man stirs up strife; but he that is slow to anger appeases even a rising one.

translations.lxx: A man slow to anger will extinguish quarrels; but an ungodly man rather stirs them up.
translations.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
translations.ron: Omul mânios aţâţă cearta, pe când cel domol linişteşte aprinderea.
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ θυμώδης παρασκευάζει μάχας· μακρόθυμος δὲ καὶ τὴν μέλλουσαν καταπρᾳΰνει· μακρόθυμος ἀνὴρ κατασβέσει κρίσεις, ὁ δὲ ἀσεβὴς ἐγείρει μᾶλλον.

verses.geez: ፍናወ፡ ሃካይያን፡ ንጹፍ፡ አሥዋክ፡ ወዘጽኑዓንሰ፡ መጽያሕት።
verses.translation: The ways of sluggards are strewn with thorns; but those of the diligent are made smooth.

translations.lxx: The ways of sluggards are strewn with thorns; but those of the diligent are made smooth.
translations.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
translations.ron: Calea celui leneş e ca un gard de spini, iar calea celui silitor e netedă.
translations.grk: Ὁδοὶ ἀεργῶν ἐστρωμέναι ἀκάνθαις, αἱ δὲ τῶν ἀνδρείων τετριμμέναι.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ፡ አባሁ፡ ወወልድ፡ ዓብድ፡ ያጼእል፡ እሞ።
verses.translation: A wise son gladdens his father; but a foolish son sneers at his mother.

translations.lxx: A wise son gladdens his father; but a foolish son sneers at his mother.
translations.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
translations.ron: Fiul înţelept bucură pe tatăl său, iar fiul nebun nu bagă în seamă pe maica lui.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς σοφὸς εὐφραίνει πατέρα, υἱὸς δὲ ἄφρων μυκτηρίζει μητέρα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ፍናወ፡ ዓብድ፡ ነዳየ፡ አእምሮ፡ ጠዋያት፡ ወብእሲሰ፡ ጠቢብ፡ አርቲዖ፡ የሐውር።
verses.translation: The ways of a foolish man are void of sense; but a wise man proceeds on his way aright.

translations.lxx: The ways of a foolish man are void of sense; but a wise man proceeds on his way aright.
translations.kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
translations.ron: Nebunia este o bucurie pentru omul fără minte, iar cel înţelept merge pe calea dreaptă.
translations.grk: Ἀνοήτου τρίβοι ἐνδεεῖς φρενῶν, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος κατευθύνων πορεύεται.

verses.geez: ያጠርዩ፡ ሕሊና፡ እለ፡ ያከብሩ፡ ማኅበረ፡ ወውስተ፡ ልበ፡ መካርያን፡ ትነብር፡ ምክር።
verses.translation: They that honour not councils put off deliberation; but counsel abides in the hearts of counsellors.

translations.lxx: They that honour not councils put off deliberation; but counsel abides in the hearts of counsellors.
translations.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
translations.ron: Punerile la cale nu se înfăptuiesc unde lipseşte chibzuirea, dar ele îşi iau fiinţă cu mulţi sfătuitori.
translations.grk: Ὑπερτίθενται λογισμοὺς οἱ μὴ τιμῶντες συνέδρια, ἐν δὲ καρδίαις βουλευομένων μένει βουλή.

verses.geez: ወኢይሰምዓ፡ ላቲ፡ እኩይ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይብል፡ ጥዑም፡ ወሠናይ፡ ለማኅበር።
verses.translation: A bad man will by no means attend to counsel; neither will he say anything seasonable, or good for the common weal.

translations.lxx: A bad man will by no means attend to counsel; neither will he say anything seasonable, or good for the common weal.
translations.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
translations.ron: Omul se bucură pentru un răspuns bun ieşit din gura lui şi cât e de bună vorba spusă la locul ei!
translations.grk: Οὐ μὴ ὑπακούσει ὁ κακὸς αὐτῇ, οὐδὲ μὴ εἴπῃ καίριόν τι καὶ καλὸν τῷ κοινῷ.

verses.geez: ፍናወ፡ ሕይወት፡ ሕሊናሁ፡ ለጠቢብ፡ ከመ፡ ተግኂሦ፡ እም፡ ሲኦል፡ ይድኅን።
verses.translation: The thoughts of the wise are ways of life, that he may turn aside and escape from hell.

translations.lxx: The thoughts of the wise are ways of life, that he may turn aside and escape from hell.
translations.kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
translations.ron: Înţeleptul merge pe cărarea vieţii ce duce în sus, ca să ocolească drumul iadului care merge în jos.
translations.grk: Ὁδοὶ ζωῆς διανοήματα συνετοῦ, ἵνα ἐκκλίνας ἐκ τοῦ ᾅδου σωθῇ.

verses.geez: አብያተ፡ ጸአልያን፡ ያንኅል፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወያጸንዕ፡ ወሰነ፡ መበለት።
verses.translation: The Lord pulls down the houses of scorners; but he establishes the border of the widow.

translations.lxx: The Lord pulls down the houses of scorners; but he establishes the border of the widow.
translations.kjv: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
translations.ron: Domnul prăbuşeşte casa celor mândri şi întăreşte hotarul văduvei.
translations.grk: Οἴκους ὑβριστῶν κατασπᾷ Κύριος, ἐστήρισε δὲ ὅριον χήρας.

verses.geez: ምኑን፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሐልዮ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወለንጹሐንሰ፡ ነገሮሙ፡ አዳም።
verses.translation: An unrighteous thought is abomination to the Lord; but the sayings of the pure are held in honour.

translations.lxx: An unrighteous thought is abomination to the Lord; but the sayings of the pure are held in honour.
translations.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
translations.ron: Gândurile cele rele sunt urâciune înaintea Domnului, iar cuvintele frumoase sunt curate (în ochii Lui).
translations.grk: Βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ λογισμὸς ἄδικος, ἁγνῶν δὲ ῥήσεις σεμναί.

verses.geez: ያኃጒል፡ ርእሶ፡ ዘሕልያነ፡ ይነሥእ፡ ወዘይጸልእሰ፡ ነሢአ፡ ሕልያን፡ ይድኅን።
verses.translation: A receiver of bribes destroys himself; but he that hates the receiving of bribes is safe.

translations.lxx: [By alms and by faithful dealings sins are purged away;] but by the fear of the Lord every one departs from evil.
translations.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
translations.ron: Cel ce umblă după câştig nedrept îşi surpă casa lui, iar cel ce urăşte mita va trăi.
translations.grk: Ἐξόλλυσιν ἑαυτὸν ὁ δωρολήπτης, ὁ δὲ μισῶν δώρων λήψεις σώζεται· ἐλεημοσύναις καὶ πίστεσιν ἀποκαθαίρονται ἁμαρτίαι, τῷ δὲ φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐκκλίνει πᾶς ἀπὸ κακοῦ.

verses.geez: በምጽዋት፡ በሃይማኖት፡ ይሠረይ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ወበፈሪሃ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይትገኃሥ፡ ኵሉ፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: The hearts of the righteous meditate faithfulness; but the mouth of the ungodly answers evil things.

translations.lxx: The ways of righteous men are acceptable with the Lord; and through them even enemies become friends.
translations.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
translations.ron: Inima celui drept chibzuieşte ce să răspundă, iar gura celor nelegiuiţi împrăştie răutăţi.
translations.grk: Καρδίαι δικαίων μελετῶσι πίστεις, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀποκρίνεται κακά· δεκταὶ παρὰ Κυρίῳ ὁδοὶ ἀνθρώπων δικαίων, διὰ δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ φίλοι γίνονται.

verses.geez: ልበ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይትሜሀር፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ወአፈ፡ ረሲዓንሰ፡ ያወሥእ፡ እኩያተ።
verses.translation: God is far from the ungodly; but he hearkens to the prayers of the righteous.

translations.lxx: Let the heart of a man think justly, that his steps may be rightly ordered of God.
translations.kjv: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
translations.ron: Domnul se ţine departe de cei nelegiuiţi, dar ascultă rugăciunea celor drepţi.
translations.grk: Μακρὰν ἀπέχει ὁ Θεὸς ἀπὸ ἀσεβῶν, εὐχαῖς δὲ δικαίων ἐπακούει· κρείσσων ὀλίγη λῆψις μετὰ δικαιοσύνης, ἢ πολλὰ γεννήματα μετὰ ἀδικίας. Καρδία ἀνδρὸς λογιζέσθω δίκαια, ἵνα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ διορθωθῇ τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ሥሙራት፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፍናወ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወበእንቲአሆሙ፡ ጸላእትኒ፡ አዕርክተ፡ ይከውኑ።
verses.translation: The eye that sees rightly rejoices the heart; and a good report fattens the bones.

translations.lxx: The eye that sees rightly rejoices the heart; and a good report fattens the bones.
translations.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
translations.ron: O privire binevoitoare înveseleşte inima şi o veste bună întăreşte oasele.
translations.grk: Θεωρῶν ὀφθαλμὸς καλὰ εὐφραίνει καρδίαν, φημη δὲ ἀγαθὴ πιαίνει ὀστᾶ.

verses.geez: ነዋኀ፡ ይርኅቅ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እምረሲዓን፡ ወጸሎተ፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ይሰምዕ፡ ይኄይስ፡ ኅዳጥ፡ ኅብስት፡ ምስለ፡ ጽድቅ፡ እምብዙኅ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ዓመፃ።
verses.translation: Let the heart of a man think justly, that his steps may be rightly ordered of God.

translations.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
translations.ron: Urechea care ascultă o dojană folositoare vieţii îşi are locaşul printre cei înţelepţi.

verses.geez: ልበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኄር፡ ይሔሊ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ከመ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይረትዕ፡ ኣሠሩ፡ ዓይን፡ ዘይኔጽር፡ ሠናየ፡ ያስተፌሥሕ፡ ልበ፡ ወዜና፡ ኂሩት፡ ያጠልል፡ አዕፅምትየ።
verses.translation: He that rejects instruction hates himself; but he that minds reproofs loves his soul.

translations.lxx: He that rejects instruction hates himself; but he that minds reproofs loves his soul.
translations.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
translations.ron: Cel ce leapădă mustrarea îşi urgiseşte sufletul său, iar cel ce ia aminte la dojană dobândeşte înţelepciune.
translations.grk: Ὃς ἀπωθεῖται παιδείαν, μισεῖ ἑαυτὸν· ὁ δὲ τηρῶν ἐλέγχους, ἀγαπᾷ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዘይሰምዕ፡ ዘለፋ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ምስለ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ይዴመር።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is instruction and wisdom; and the highest honour will correspond therewith.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord is instruction and wisdom; and the highest honour will correspond therewith.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
translations.ron: Frica de Dumnezeu este învăţătură şi înţelepciune, iar smerenia trece înaintea măririi.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου παιδεία καὶ σοφία, καὶ ἀρχὴ δόξης ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: ወዘይትከላእ፡ እምተግሣፅ፡ ይጸልእ፡ ርእሶ፡ ዘያፈቅርሰ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ያፈቅር፡ ርእሶ።
